caption: The drawing depicts a circular composition featuring a bouquet of white flowers with yellow centers and hints of pink on the petals, arranged with green leaves and fern-like foliage. The flowers and leaves are centrally positioned with details such as visible veins on the petals and serrated edges on the leaves. In the upper left quadrant of the circle, there is a depiction of a white spider web against a dark background. The circular area has a gradient background that transitions from dark greenish-black along the top and sides to lighter green and cream tones at the bottom. There is an area of damage at the top right of the circle where the color has been scraped off, revealing the paper beneath. The drawing is signed and dated in small script near the lower right edge inside the circle. The composition is set against a plain beige or light tan background.
title: Pa. German Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
